mintAuthority.summary: GGBR is minted exclusively through the GoldfishTokenFactory contract (MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN held by a single issuer EOA). The GoldfishToken contract itself is administered by a 2-of-3 Safe that controls setMinterContract() and UUPS upgrades. Redemptions burn through the same factory.

upgradeability.controlRef: GoldfishToken admin Safe — upgrade and minterContract rotation

controls.label: GoldfishTokenFactory (minterContract) — issuer EOA operator
controls.capDescription: At Ethereum block 26,097,123, maxSupply is 1,000,000,000 GGBR. Both ordinary issuance and staking-reward issuance enter the token mint() guard. The factory EOA has factory mint and upgrade roles but neither the token SUPPLY_MANAGER_ROLE nor token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Its broad indirect cap capability remains unknown; no protective cap credit is inferred. The token Safe holds SUPPLY_MANAGER_ROLE and can increase the ceiling without posting more backing. The asset-wide economic cap remains unbounded.
bypassSurfaces: Factory DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can upgrade its UUPS minting implementation.
Factory mintStakingRewards accepts the configured StakeMyGold contract in addition to the issuer MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26,095,795 on 2026-10-01, minterContract() returns factory 0x765c0af86952604f1576ca3b5beb75420d75ff62, whose EIP-1967 implementation is 0x05a106559954a372baad1af06fe644f8c4796ed1. hasRole(MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE, 0xd22d50e306b439015a5b01be65bb8e7ebc0bc2f4) and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, the same EOA) return true. Verified factory code allows its DEFAULT_ADMIN to authorize UUPS upgrades and exposes an additional mintStakingRewards path through stakingContract 0xd0a21f885e53f53b0947f8699677c09dae32523b. The EOA does not hold the token's SUPPLY_MANAGER_ROLE; cap changes require that role, which the recorded token Safe holds. These calls do not enumerate all role holders.

controls.label: GoldfishToken admin Safe — upgrade and minterContract rotation
controls.capDescription: The token Safe holds SUPPLY_MANAGER_ROLE and may increase maxSupply through setMaxSupply; the current 1,000,000,000-GGBR technical ceiling is therefore mutable. Its token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE also controls UUPS upgrades and minterContract rotation.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26,095,795 on 2026-10-01, token hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, Safe 0xd0022c3ed6a11bf6791ba2c9d0b394021a6096e4) and hasRole(SUPPLY_MANAGER_ROLE, the same Safe) return true. RPC confirms the three recorded owners, threshold 2, version 1.4.1, no enabled modules, zero guard, and the recorded fallback handler. The token's implementation remains 0x35fef16fea897dd6ca2e28041dbfb8d56e2978d6; its verified code restricts setMinterContract and UUPS _authorizeUpgrade to DEFAULT_ADMIN and setMaxSupply to SUPPLY_MANAGER_ROLE.

review.evidence: Historical review at Ethereum block 25295025 identified the factory operator EOA, token admin Safe and factory mint path. The August 15, 2026 review called reconciliation continuous because a designated collateral wallet could be compared with total GGBR supply. Under owner ruling D22, wallet totals alone do not document reserve-to-liability procedures for the exact token. The collateral and support pages rechecked October 1, 2026 advertise live totals and issuer-stated in-situ gold but do not publish a dated token-specific reconciliation engagement; current reconciliation is unknown, not absent. At block 26097123, both active implementations are unchanged, the factory EOA holds factory mint/admin roles but not token supply-manager/admin roles, and the token Safe holds SUPPLY_MANAGER_ROLE. Ordinary issuance and staking rewards enter the token cap guard; the Safe can raise that ceiling without a reserve-posting condition. D14 therefore retains the adverse asset-wide unbounded cap semantics while the EOA's broad indirect cap capability remains unknown.
